hook.name: TickerHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for tokenized-stock pools that sets dynamic LP fees based on the US equity market session (regular/extended/closed hours, with DST-aware onchain clock) and Chainlink oracle price gaps to capture arbitrage as LP income. Also takes a protocol fee on the unspecified swap side, with discounts for TKR token stakers.
